Boot the image under QEMU/OVMF across the frozen acceptance matrix — nominal 1/2/4/8 CPUs, AP-failure, and reboot — and keep the serial evidence per scenario. A scenario that is not run is reported as not run, never as passing.

```day-atom
{"in":["bootable-image"],"out":["boot-evidence"],"next":["determinism-check"],"done":["boot-evidence"]}
```
